01 / THE DISCONNECTED WORKFLOW

Specialty insurance runs on data.
Too much of it still travels as documents.

Risk information starts in an email, becomes a spreadsheet, then a PDF. At every handover, someone recreates what someone else already knows.

For brokers, MGAs and carriers, that means duplicated work, inconsistent records and reconciliation that takes longer than it should.

PDFExcelEmail
↓   Manual processing   ↓
MGA→ Bordereau →Carrier
↓   Manual registration. Again.
With Bordeon   →   One shared structure.
02 / THE PLATFORM CONCEPT

03 / A RECORD THAT REMEMBERS

Every change becomes a transaction.

A change in insured value should create a new endorsement, not erase the original policy.

Bordeon is designed to preserve the sequence: policy, endorsement, premium adjustment, bordereau and settlement. A clear history of what changed, when and why.

Policy→Endorsement→Premium adjustment

04 / STRUCTURED AT THE SOURCE

The bordereau becomes an output — not your database.

Start with the transaction, then generate the format each counterparty requires. The underlying insurance information stays consistent.

Documents, spreadsheets and API messages become different views of the same record.

THE LONGER VIEW

Built for specialty.
Starting in Europe.

Bordeon is an early-stage platform concept focused initially on European marine and specialty insurance.

The ambition extends beyond any one class of business: remove unnecessary translation of insurance information between organisations, from distribution through capacity and settlement.

We are inviting industry perspectives to shape the initial product.

LET’S BUILD IT TOGETHER

Help build the infrastructure specialty insurance actually needs.

We are working with specialty insurance professionals to design Bordeon around real underwriting, bordereau and settlement workflows.

Marine and specialty MGAs, brokers and carriers across Europe.
